Please Note:
The above USDA LPGMN price report is reflective of the majority of classes and quality of hay offered for sale. There may be
instances where some sales do not fit within reporting guidelines and therefore will not be included in the report. Prices are
reported on an FOB basis, unless otherwise noted.
